rules: A case opens at the first game missed in a run of injury absences (box scores, with the listing in effect at each game) and ends with the run, at a game played or missed for another reason; the return is the next game played. Off the latest listing is not a return. Reviewed daily for 7 days, then weekly, until the case ends. College box scores don't say why a player sat out, so there a missed game without a listing can extend a run.
